units.text: Two ESCAPADE spacecraft launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on November 13, 2025, aboard Blue Origin's New Glenn launch vehicle.

judgement.reason: The passages support launch from Cape Canaveral on Nov. 13, 2025 aboard Blue Origin's New Glenn, but do not mention that there were two ESCAPADE spacecraft.

units.text: The launch occurred at 3:55 p.m. EST on November 13, 2025.

judgement.reason: The launch date and time table states Nov. 13, 2025, 3:55 p.m. EST, and the other passage confirms the Nov. 13, 2025 launch.
